thread:
harper: Small creative ask for Apr webinar inbound: one compact hero benchmark (1600x900), a 3-card modular tile set (600x600) for email/social, 3 social templates (IG/LI/X) with an accessible color swap, and a micro-badge for SDR emails. Deadline: static comps by tomorrow 10am PT.

dylan: We can take it. Quick q: hero metric pair? cost_per_1000 vs p95_ms or tokens/sec vs cost?

harper: Use cost_per_1000 (x) vs p95_ms (y). Show two qualitative callouts: "lower-cost" and "better tail latency". No numeric claims.

dylan: Deliverable checklist:
- MIQ_launch2026_herobench_1600x900_static (svg/png/jpg)
- MIQ_launch2026_tiles_600x600_A/B/C (2 copy variants each)
- MIQ_launch2026_social_ig_1080x1080_static+gif
- MIQ_launch2026_social_li_1200x627_mp4+static
- MIQ_launch2026_social_x_800x450_static+gif
- MIQ_launch2026_badge_email_round+pill (transparent pngs)

ivy: Brand: use type-scale v3, neutral canvas for charts (no gradients). Footer lockup: "Redwood Inference  production-ready inference" and source: "internal benchmark; illustrative". Alt text drafts required for all assets.

margo: Legal: avoid dollar or SLA language. Keep annotations qualitative. I'll do a quick sweep after comps. Also ensure AA contrast for text/annotation strokes.

sam: Metrics: uploading CSV now (drive.redwood/bench/2026-mini-launch.csv). We'll flag p95 > 2200ms as outliers. CTAs: "Try a demo", "Watch on demand", APAC short: "Demo".

dylan: Animation note: sparkline loop 10 frames, target GIF <1.6MB for IG; MP4 fallback for LinkedIn. We will also export SVG funnels for email.

assets-bot: Naming/tag reminder: tag frames in Figma with release/launch-inbound/2026-04-14. Use MIQ_launch2026_{asset}_{channel}_{variant}. Automated export picks tagged frames.

harper: I'll drop landing thumbnail copy in 30m. Please post first comps ASAP so we can run brand/legal sweep. Thanks! :rocket:
